description: Bullrun's company relationship graph for one stock: named competitors, suppliers, customers and partners, each with its Bullrun ticker when the counterparty is listed, verification status (VERIFIED against a primary filing/source vs search-SUGGESTED), confidence, sole-source flag, quantified dependence where disclosed (e.g. "Cirrus Logic gets 91% of revenue from Apple") and the evidence behind it. Use for supply-chain and second-order risk questions ("who supplies X", "who depends on X", "who competes with X", "which listed companies are exposed if X stumbles"), then call get_company_risk or get_stock_metrics on the counterparties' tickers. Returns only the cached graph and never starts a paid discovery run; a company with no graph yet reports status "none". A missing edge is not proof of no relationship. Read-only. Successful results include an optional platformLink for continuing this research or reviewing the exact saved draft in Bullrun. When useful, present its descriptive link and respect its description of any settings not carried over.

evidence.description: none = counts only; sources = source title/URL/type per edge; excerpts = also the quoted evidence text.

limitPerRole.description: Max counterparties per role, verified and highest-confidence first.

roles.description: Which relationships to return, from this company's point of view. Default: all four.

ticker.description: Exact Bullrun ticker, native local-exchange symbol (e.g. "AAPL", "SAP", "ASML"); no Yahoo-style suffixes.

verifiedOnly.description: true = only edges confirmed against a primary source (filing, company release). false also returns search-suggested edges, each labelled with its status and confidence.

name: get_company_relationships
title: Get company relationship network
